_comment: The scrapes Andy's mates (and a few others) get into. 'who' is a character id. 'kind': help = they are stood further down the piste, ski up to them and hold ACT; fetch = grab the item by skiing over it ('item' is an object sprite; 'slides' makes it slide off down the mountain); chase = they are skiing near you, catch them and hold ACT before 'time' runs out; snowball = a chase where they throw snowballs at you; wild = a chase where they are all over the piste (hitting them knocks you over); lift = they are on the chairlift going up, ski under them and hold ACT; phone = stop dead (brake to a standstill) and stay stopped to take the call. 'pose' is how they are drawn while waiting. 'say' is what they shout, 'andy' is what Andy says when he sorts it, 'thanks' is their reply. 'weight' makes a scrape more or less common. 'from' is the first day (0 = Monday) it can happen.

scrapes.title: Kinky Steve has stripped to his pants for a selfie. It's minus twelve.
say: Get one of me and the mountain!
Make sure you get my good side!
andy: Put the onesie back on, Steve.
Nobody needs to see that, Steve.

scrapes.title: Kinky Steve is chatting up the ski instructor. She is not interested.
say: Fancy giving me a private lesson?
I've got my own onesie, you know.
Do you come here often? Oh. You work here.
andy: Leave the poor woman alone, Steve.

scrapes.title: Kinky Steve's onesie zip has gone. Grab the gaffer tape before he freezes.
andy: That's the last of the tape, Steve.

scrapes.title: Jimmy Ginge is pelting you with snowballs.
thanks: It was only a bit of fun!

scrapes.title: Jimmy Ginge has burnt to a crisp. Grab some suncream!
andy: You're the colour of a postbox, Jimmy.

scrapes.title: Jimmy Ginge's goggles have steamed up. He's hugging a tree.
Plug has fallen over. Again.
andy: That's the ninth time today, Plug.

scrapes.title: Plug's lost a ski and it's off down the mountain on its own.
andy: Got it! Not that you'll need it.

scrapes.title: Plug is doing a snowplough across the whole piste.
andy: Skis parallel. Like this. LIKE THIS.

scrapes.title: KFT says he knows a shortcut. Through the trees.
andy: We are NOT going through the trees.
Last time you said that we ended up in Italy.

scrapes.title: KFT has dropped the piste map. It's the only one.
andy: It was upside down anyway, KFT.
thanks: Right! I know exactly where we are!

scrapes.title: KFT is heading for a schnapps. It's ten in the morning.
Sid's fallen asleep on the chairlift. He's been round six times.
Sid's lost his lift pass. Again.
say: It was in my pocket a minute ago...
andy: Put it on the lanyard, Sid.
That's the third one this week.

scrapes.title: Sid has sat down for a little rest. In the middle of the piste.
andy: Up. Now. Before someone hits you.

scrapes.title: The Aging Rocker is doing air guitar on skis. He's going to take someone out.
andy: Both hands on the poles, you dinosaur!
It's a ski slope, not Wembley.

scrapes.title: The Aging Rocker's back has gone. Find his Deep Heat.
andy: Rock and roll never dies. Your back does.

scrapes.title: The Aging Rocker won't wear a helmet. It ruins the hair.
say: Helmets are for the bass player!
Do you know who I used to be?
andy: Nobody's looked at that hair since 1986.
thanks: I look like a bus driver.

scrapes.title: Lycra Lee is here in a speed suit, cutting everyone up.
say: Out of the way, I'm on a segment!
andy: It's a holiday, Lee. SLOW. DOWN.
Nobody cares about your segment, Lee.
thanks: Fine. See you at the bottom. FIRST.

scrapes.title: Alistair's here. He's banned from the resort and nicking people's chips.
say: I'm not banned in THIS country!

scrapes.title: Banter Bob is slagging off Leeds United at the side of the piste.
say: When did Leeds last win anything?
andy: Leeds are the greatest club in the world. END OF.

scrapes.title: The Club Chairman is ringing. You're on holiday. Stop and take it.
andy: I'm halfway up a mountain, Chairman.
